codex-runtime.action: Route to Codex execution: use newer models for broad refactors, in-app browser for UI verification, and worktrees for parallel fixes.

hooks.action: Route to Claude Code quality gates: SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit for session context, PostToolUse/Stop for lint-test feedback.

quality-cost.action: Route to cost and safety controls: deny-by-default checks, budget routing, and telemetry before wider automation.

schedule.action: Route to GitHub Actions or Codex Automations: daily source watch, merge-backlog triage, and deterministic CI/deploy checks.
